Reposting from Vicente Romano lll Facebook Page .. 

———————-

SARI-SARING COUP

Kasado na ang 3-day rally na inoorganize ng INC sa Luneta at EDSA sa November 16-18. 

Kasama nila dito ang KOJC ni Quiboloy at JIL ni Bro Eddie. (Yung KOJC expected. Yung JIL, disappointing, but understandable dahil priority nila ma protektahan si JoelV.)

Inaasahang at least 300,000/day ang imomobilize nila sa 2 venues

Ang magiging panawagan daw nila ay ACCOUNTABILITY.

E kung yan lang, bakit hindi na lang sila sumama sa November 30 rally na yan din naman ang panawagan? Di sana ma amplify pa ang boses ng sambayanang Pilipino.

Obviously, iba ang agenda nila.

Kaya 3 days yan, dahil sinusunod nila yung template of regime change ng EDSA 1 and 2 - several days of massive rallies followed by a withdrawal of support by the military.

So malamang, meron na rin silang kausap na active generals.

Matatandaan na nung Sept 21 rally, nabalita na ang INC magmomobilize daw ng 500,000 sa Luneta. Pero umatras sila sa last minute, dahil hindi nila na convince si Brawner na mag withdraw ng support at iluklok si Sara.

Meanwhile, malakas na naman ang ugong na may coup sa Senado sa Lunes, Nov 10. Si Cayetano ang ipapalit kay Sotto.

Ang game plan? Ibalik si Marcoleta sa Blue Ribbon, i-convene ng mabilisan, at mag present ng “star” witness na magdidiin kay BBM.

Ito ngayon ang magiging basehan ng bagong panawagan sa Nov 16-18 rally na patalsikin si BBM, at ipalit si Sara.

Ano ba ang urgency? Bakit parang natataranta ang Duterte forces and allies na iluklok na agad si Sara?

E kasi may mga isasampa ng malversation at plunder cases laban kina Chiz, Jinggoy, atJoel V. Non-bailable at kulong agad sila. And papunta na ang ICI investigations sa time ni Duterte. So, tatamaan sina Bong Go, Villar, at Duterte family mismo.

Ang mas mahalagang tanong - ANO ANG GAGAWIN NATIN? 

Hindi naman pwedeng maging passive observers lang tayo habang may mga pwersang gustong ibalik ang regime ng kadiliman.

For their plan to succeed, kailangan meron active General(s) na magwithdraw ng support. 

Pero sa mga military chat groups, wala naman chatter na the top brass will be involved. Lalo pa na karamihan sa top brass natin are Amboys, and alam naman nila na super pro-China si Sara.

So, at best, 2nd or 3rd tier Generals lang ang pwedeng mag declare ng withdrawal of support.

Ngayon, bago ito mag-snowball, at maisip ng top brass na ito ang sentimento ng taumbayan, kailangan handa tayong lumabas sa kalye on short notice para ipakita na hindi sila ang boses ng taumbayan. TAYO ANG TUNAY NA BOSES.

Ano ang isisigaw natin? “Marcos pa rin?”  Hhhhmmmm… medyo awkward.

Pero, if that’s what it takes to prevent the return of the regime of darkness, “WHY NOT, CHOCONUT?”

Paki-share para ma alert ang mga pwersa natin.

After a 6 hour drive from Angeles to Dinadiawan, Philippines, I am EXHAUSTED. After doing some scouting, @OreboundImages and I were hit with the reality that we could truly be stuck here for some time due to the considerable landslide threat. Driving through the mountains we passed a minimum of 20 slides ranging from small to big. 

We made the decision to hold up in Dinadiawan and wait to see what the forecasted path of soon to be Typhoon #UwanPH is. If it shifts north, we will be faced with trekking the only road up to Casiguran which will surely be covered by landslides and significant flooding as the storm passes. If it goes south, we will continue searching for a place to ride out this beast. The other issue we are running into is hotels refusing stay due to the incoming typhoon. So this will have to be monitored! 

Time for some sleep! 
-Jordan 
#Typhoon #Fungwong #PhilippineWeather #wxtwitter
